summary: Frontend-only perf retest for iPhone-slow-load fix. All perf optimizations verified working. Before scrolling on mobile (390x844), only 2 /shots/*.webp images are fetched (custom.webp hero + monthly.webp default active tab) — the other 8 dashboard images are correctly deferred until the showcase section is near the viewport. After scrolling to showcase, remaining images are fetched and auto-advance runs (~1s cycle). Desktop hover-pause works. Buy flow (hero-cta-buy -> buy-modal -> buy-email-input -> buy-submit -> buy-success -> buy-download-button) is functional. Fonts render in Cabinet Grotesk (not serif fallback). No console errors, no 404s.

perf_metrics_mobile_390x844.auto_advance: OK (caption changed within 1.3s of entering viewport)

desktop_1440x820_checks.buy_flow: OK (modal -> email -> submit -> success -> download button visible)

observations_non_blocking: Showcase useEffect re-preloads all TABS (including monthly.webp and custom.webp) when inView flips true — both are already cached, so cost is negligible (304/from cache). Optional micro-opt: skip re-preloading the currently active tab and the hero image.

sticky-buy-bar testid was not found via query on desktop 1440 viewport but is clearly rendered on mobile (visible in screenshot with countdown 14:53 and BUY NOW). Likely hidden on desktop by design (sm:hidden). Not a regression — noted for awareness.
critical_code_review_comments: Showcase.js: image preload loop re-loads all 10 tab images when inView triggers, including the currently-displayed one and the hero (custom.webp) which is already in browser cache. Fine functionally, minor waste.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Perf optimizations validated end-to-end on the public preview URL. Key numbers: mobile DOMContentLoaded ~737ms, load ~1365ms, only 2 /shots/*.webp fetched before scroll (custom+monthly), remaining 8 fetched after scrolling into the showcase (IntersectionObserver rootMargin 300px). Auto-advance, hover-pause, buy-modal flow, sticky bar (mobile), and fonts (Cabinet Grotesk) all confirmed working with 0 console errors and 0 HTTP 4xx/5xx.
